entities.summary: Roman Romanovich Romanchuk was a Ukrainian and Russian amateur boxer. He won silver at super heavyweight during the 2005 World Amateur Boxing Championships and helped the Russian team win the 2005 Boxing World Cup. He also had success as an amateur kickboxer.
